Definition: multiple adverb from G3739; how (i.e. with G302, so) many times as:--as oft(-en) as.
BiblicalUsage: The word hosákis carries the sense of as often as. In 1 Corinthians 11:25, the text says "as oft as ye drink [it]."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hosákis as it stands: as often as.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; The Two Witnesses
